review: Claim #PI-482917 was handled faster than I expected, and the reimbursement hit my account within a week of submitting the vet invoice. The portal was easy, the adjuster answered my questions clearly, and it made a stressful surgery much easier to manage. The instructors explain things in a practical way, the exercises actually build on each other, and the certificates were easy to share with my manager. I even took a cooking photography class just for fun after finishing the work courses. Navigation is simple, playback works well, and the mobile app saved my commute. I recommend it without hesitation.

The app has a decent show list, but actually watching anything is a pain. It buffers all the time on my TV, subtitles randomly lag, and it logged me out twice in one night. Maybe it works better for other people, but I'm cancelling before the next bill hits.

The streaming service is okay, honestly. I like the original shows and the app works pretty well on my TV, but the movie selection is kinda thin and they rotate stuff out before I finish watching it. The ads on the cheaper plan are annoying too, not gonna lie. Still, for the price it's decent, and if you just want something easy for weeknights I'd recomend it.

Clean app, instant notifications, and mobile check deposit actually works the first time. I’d recommend it.

and then the replacement prints arrived even worse than the originals. Faces were orange, two corners were bent, and half the order was cropped differently from the preview. Customer service offered store credit like I would ever use them again. Complete waste of my wedding photo files and my time.

I've bought probably thirty games through this marketplace and it's been excellent. Keys show up quickly, downloads are straightforward, and the wishlist alerts have saved me a surprising amount of money. I had contacted support last year about a duplicate purchase, and they sorted it out within an afternoon, so I felt confident using them again. No drama, good prices, and everything in my library stays easy to find. Definitely my first stop now when a sale starts.

honestly this course platform was a mess. videos kept freezing, the quizzes marked correct answers wrong, and the certificate never showed up even tho I finished everything. support said theyd get back to me and then ghosted. total waste of my weekend and money, dont bother.

I started using this app because my sister married someone from Chile and I thought it would be nice to learn enough Spanish to talk to his parents when they visit, and at first the little owl reminders or whatever were kind of cute, but after a few weeks it was just nonsense repetition and ads and pressure to pay. Then it lost my progress twice, put me back into beginner lessons, and charged me after I thought I had canceled the trial. No actual help from support, just canned emails. I regret downloading it.

The VPN connects, so I guess that is something, but it slows my laptop to a crawl and randomly drops when I need it most. The server list looks impressive until you realize most locations are overloaded. Customer support sent canned instructions that did not fix anything. What is the point of paying for privacy if the connection keeps exposing you anyway? I would not recommend this unless you enjoy troubleshooting.

I took two analytics courses here and found the lessons clear, practical, and easy to fit around work. The quizzes actually reinforced the material instead of feeling like filler. I had a previous contact with support when my certificate didn't generate, and they fixed it the same day. My only caveat is that some discussion forums are quiet, so don't expect a lively classroom feel in every course. Even so, I'd recommend it for self-paced learning.

Hello, I submitted a claim for my dog's emergency visit and provided every record requested. The claim was denied on a technicality that was never made clear when I enrolled, and the appeal process took weeks with no useful updates. I appreciate the polite representatives, but the coverage was not there when we needed it. I cannot recommend this company.

Regards,
Megan
Payroll was late twice and tax filings showed the wrong state. Support kept passing us between agents, so I would not use this platform again.

Ticket #TV-483921. The streaming service constantly buffers even though my internet tests fine and every other app works. Several shows listed as included suddenly asked for an extra rental fee, and customer support simply told me to reinstall the app, which I had already done. The catalog has a few good series, but the technical problems make it frustrating almost every night. I cancelled and would not tell anyone to sign up.

Ticket PR-77914 was my only support issue, and it was resolved within a day. Overall this payroll platform has made pay runs much easier for our small business. Tax filings, direct deposits, and contractor payments are all in one place, and the interface is clean enough that I do not dread payroll week anymore. My only complaint is that some report exports require extra clicks and could be labeled better. Even with that, I would recommend it to other small employers.

After my previous contact with support about the room sensor pairing, the thermostat has been working much better. Scheduling is easy, the app is responsive, and it has trimmed our heating use a bit. The only gripe is that the learning mode made a few odd temperature changes the first week. Still, I’d recommend it.

The meal-kit boxes have made weeknights so much easier for us. The produce has been fresh, the recipe cards are clear, and even my picky teenager has found meals she likes. Is there anything better than not having to answer “what’s for dinner” at 5:30? Definitely recommend.

The policy has been useful, but it is not as smooth as I hoped. I contacted support back in March about pre-approval for dental work and they were polite, though the answer took two follow-ups. Claims are paid, just slowly, and the wording around exclusions is harder to understand than it should be. I still think it is worth having if your pet is young and you can budget for the waiting, but go in expecting paperwork and patience.

Ticket #MB-482917: the app locked me out three times, duplicated a transfer, and then support told me to wait five business days while my rent money sat in limbo. Biometrics stopped working after the update and the balance shown was wrong for hours. I regret moving my banking here and would not trust it with another dollar.

Our organization experienced an unacceptable level of service from this registrar. A routine renewal failed despite valid payment details, and the domain was allowed to lapse without meaningful notice. Support responses were slow, templated, and did not address the operational impact to our business. The control panel also produced conflicting status information during the incident. We have transferred our portfolio elsewhere and cannot recommend this provider for any business-critical domains.

I moved my domain there because years ago a friend used them for a hobby blog, and I thought a registrar is a registrar, right? Unfortunately the control panel is confusing, DNS updates took longer than expected, and they kept presenting add-ons at every step. The worst part was support: I had to explain the same issue three times, and the answer was basically a link to a help article I had already read. The domain eventually worked, so it was not a total disaster, but I would not choose them again or suggest them to anyone running an important site.

I purchased this pet insurance expecting some peace of mind for my older cat, but the experience was deeply disappointing. The sales materials made the coverage sound straightforward, yet nearly every claim was denied as pre-existing or incomplete. I submitted vet records three different times and still received generic emails saying documents were missing. Phone support was polite but unable to explain the decisions. After months of premiums, I received almost no reimbursement for a very expensive treatment. In my opinion, the policy gave the illusion of protection without actually helping when it mattered.

I moved my little woodworking blog over to this host after years of just keeping it on a free platform, mostly because my nephew kept telling me I needed my own domain if I was going to sell cutting boards at craft fairs. Setup took me an evening because I’m not exactly a web person, but the control panel mostly made sense, and the site has been loading a lot faster than before. I had one weird email forwarding issue that took a day to sort out, so it’s not flawless, but I’m glad I switched and would suggest them to other small site owners.

Membership under order #CW-18472 was a disappointment: noisy phone booths, spotty Wi-Fi, and the "reserved" desk I paid for was twice occupied by someone else. Staff were polite, but not helpful enough for me to recommend signing up.

The meal kit idea is nice and some recipes tasted good, but I cannot recommend this subscription. Two boxes arrived with warm meat and broken sauce packets. The vegetables was not fresh, sometimes already brown. Instructions also say 25 minutes but for me it is almost one hour. Customer service gave small credit, but next delivery had missing ingredient again. For this money I prefer buy food myself.

Very good insurance for my dog. I am not native English speaker but their forms was clear and easy to send. My puppy had stomach problem and vet bill was big for me. They paid fast after I upload invoice, and support answer with kindness. I feel calm now because I know he is protected. I recommend this company very much.

I wanted to like this mattress store, but the whole purchase was a mistake. The mattress arrived a week late in a torn box, and once opened it never fully expanded at the corners. It also smelled strongly for days, even with the windows open. Customer service kept asking for new photos instead of arranging a return, then claimed the trial period started on the order date, not delivery. After two weeks my back hurt more than before and I was still arguing over pickup. I regret buying from them and would warn others to avoid the hassle.

Our company purchased several game licenses through this marketplace for an internal event. The transaction was processed, but two keys were invalid and one title was removed from the library without explanation. Customer support requested repeated screenshots and then closed the case without resolution. The refund policy was applied inconsistently and the communication record was inadequate. Based on this experience, I would not use this marketplace again and cannot recommend it for personal or business purchases.

The programme has become materially less useful for business travellers. Award availability is limited, upgrade requests clear inconsistently, and recent rule changes were communicated poorly. Customer service could not provide a coherent explanation for a missing mileage credit, despite supporting documentation. While the route network remains strong, the loyalty proposition no longer justifies directing corporate travel toward this airline. I would not advise colleagues to rely on it.
paid for a year and it barely worked on my phone constant disconnects no refunds support kept blaming my wifi but every other app was fine save your money

pretty solid for learning on the bus honestly
videos load fast and the instructors explain things well
i wish the quizzes were less buggy on my phone and the app forgets my place sometimes but ive finished two classes already and would tell friends to try it

The scooters were charged, easy to unlock, and surprisingly sturdy over rough pavement. Pricing was clear and the app ended the ride instantly. What more do you want from a quick trip across town? I would absolutely use it again.

Hello, I’ve been using this banking app for everyday checking, transfers, and mobile deposits, and it has been excellent. The layout is clear, alerts arrive quickly, and I appreciate how easy it is to freeze my card or move money between accounts. Depositing a check took less than a minute and the status updates were reassuring. It feels secure without being annoying. I’m very happy with it and would gladly recommend it. Kind regards.

Used the scooter rental all weekend while visiting downtown and it was honestly the easiest part of the trip. The app unlocked the scooter in seconds, the brakes felt solid, and the parking zones were clearly marked. Why pay for a rideshare to crawl through traffic when you can zip along the bike lane and actually enjoy the weather? Pricing was transparent, too. I will definitely use them again.
Cheap domains, awful renewals and confusing transfers. I can't recommend them.
Installed easily, learns the schedule fast, and noticeably lowered our heating bill. Excellent smart thermostat.
Colors were dull, shipping was late. I wouldn’t use them again.

We bought from this mattress site after moving into our first house, and I probably over-researched it because my old apartment mattress had given me a stiff neck for years. Ordering was easy, delivery came when they said, and the bed expanded without that chemical smell I was worried about. It is firmer than the photos and descriptions made it sound, so side sleepers may need a topper. Still, after a few weeks both of us are sleeping better, and the return policy made the purchase feel low risk. I would recommend them.

honestly this tracker is junk lol. steps are way off, sleep data is random, and it dies before dinner even after a full charge. the app keeps crashing and syncing takes foreverrr. i missed the return window and im mad about it. dont waste ur money.

After a full quarter of use, this project-management platform has proven unsuitable for our organization. Core automations failed without notice, permissions behaved inconsistently, and reporting exports were incomplete. These issues created operational risk and required substantial manual correction. We will not renew the contract and cannot recommend the service.

I moved my small shop site here after many problems with old host, and honestly it is excellent. The control panel is clear even for me not very technical, SSL installed in few minutes, and my pages load much more fast now. I asked one question in chat and the answer was polite and simple. For the price this hosting is very good value. I am happy to recommend to other small business owners.

Order #FT-10936 arrived quickly, and the band is comfortable, but that is about the only praise I can give. Heart-rate readings are frequently off during workouts, sleep tracking misses whole hours, and the battery barely lasts two days despite the advertising. Support suggested resetting it, which did not help. I would not buy this tracker again.
Frequent downtime, slow tickets, not worth it.

- Purchased a game and the code was already redeemed
- Refund request sat unanswered for days
- Store page still showed the item as available
- The only positive is that the website itself loads fast
- Not worth the risk when there are better places to buy
The course content is okay, but the platform freezes during quizzes and support is slow. Unless you are very patient, I would look for a more reliable option.

Pretty impressed with this banking app. Signup was quick, transfers land fast, and the spending categories are actually useful instead of just looking fancy. I had one weird bug where my balance didnt refresh until I logged out, which made me nervous for a minute, but support replied fast. I’d recommend it if you want a simple mobile-first bank and don’t need a physical branch.

I bought this fitness tracker after my doctor gently hinted that my "daily walk" from the couch to the mailbox was not quite a lifestyle plan. I have tried two cheaper bands before and they both ended up in a drawer with old phone chargers, so I was skeptical. This one, though, has been fantastic. The step tracking seems consistent, the sleep report is weirdly motivating, and the battery lasts long enough that I forget where I put the charger. I also like the gentle buzz reminders because they nag me without feeling rude. The app took me an evening to learn, but now I check it constantly. Honestly it has made me move more, and I would absolutely recommend it.

The streaming service has a decent catalog, but the live rewind feature is a mess. It freezes, jumps back to the wrong spot, or dumps me at the live point right when I’m trying to catch a missed play. Add in random buffering during prime time and I can’t recommend it unless they fix the basics.
